thread:
mei: FYI: planning a staged rollout for v3.9.1 in the 22:30-00:00 window. Need to coordinate EU edge canary.
release-bot: Preflight OK for artifact def456. Canary plan: 1% x10m -> 5% x15m -> 20% x20m. Smoke PASS.
jordan: infra flag 0: there's maintenance 22:45 on eu-west-3. Recommend start at 23:05 to avoid overlap.
mei: 23:05 works for product. Will we need to extend canary?
nate: extend 1% to 15m if we start later. Also pin rollback target to v3.9.0.
sasha: oncall: set rollback triggers: 5xx > 1% over 3m OR p95 +35% -> auto-pause. Route alerts to #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: Deploy command queued.
mei: running promote now: `releasebot promote --artifact def456 --to 1% --duration 15m --pin v3.9.0 --window 23:05-23:45`
(deploy-bot logs)
deploy-bot: canary 1% deployed. initial healthchecks OK.
jordan: monitoring infra, no maintenance overlap.
(deploy-bot) +8m: slight p95 increase +8% isolated to eu-west-1 synthetic, 5xx stable.
nate: manual probe shows 200s. proceed to 5%.
mei: rolling to 5% now.
deploy-bot: 5% rollout in progress.
(deploy-bot) +6m into 5%: anomaly: burst of 503s in eu-west-3 at 1.4% over 1m.
jordan: seeing a transient autoscaler event; nodes drained then reattached. working mitigation.
sasha: recommend PAUSE and revert to 1% while infra stabilizes.
mei: PAUSE and demote to pinned v3.9.0 at 5%.
release-bot: `releasebot rollback --to v3.9.0 --scope eu-west --from 5% --reason "503 burst during autoscale"`
deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic back to v3.9.0. Healthchecks recovering.
jordan: autoscaler fix applied; will observe for 15m.
mei: noted. I'll update RL ticket and release notes with the rollback and next steps.
nate: follow-up: add autoscaler warmup synthetic to preflight.
sasha: oncall will draft a short incident summary.
mei: thanks all. retargeting v3.9.1 for next quiet window. :thumbsup:
